package fixture

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestZodDefaultsAndRecovery(t *testing.T) {
	v, err := Decode[Options]([]byte(`{"required":[1,"bad",2],"url":"not a url"}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if v.Count != 3 || v.Label == nil || *v.Label != "hello" || len(v.Required) != 2 || v.Required[1] != 2 || v.URL != nil {
		t.Fatalf("wrong normalization: %+v", v)
	}
	if _, err := Decode[Options]([]byte(`{}`)); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), `$["required"]`) {
		t.Fatalf("missing required input accepted: %v", err)
	}
	v, err = Decode[Options]([]byte(`{"required":"bad"}`))
	if err != nil || len(v.Required) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("required recovery failed: %+v %v", v, err)
	}
	if Validate[Options]([]byte(`{"required":[],"count":null}`)) == nil {
		t.Fatal("default applied to null instead of missing")
	}
	if Validate[Count]([]byte(`3.5`)) == nil || Validate[Count]([]byte(`11`)) == nil || Validate[Count]([]byte(`-1`)) == nil {
		t.Fatal("numeric constraints ignored")
	}
	if Validate[Count]([]byte(`0`)) != nil {
		t.Fatal("inclusive zero bound failed")
	}
}
func TestZodCustomUnion(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := Decode[Message]([]byte(`{"kind":"text","text":42}`)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("malformed known variant passed through catch-all")
	}
	good, err := Decode[Message]([]byte(`{"kind":"text","text":"ok","note":42,"vendor":true}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(good)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw := string(encoded)
	if strings.Contains(raw, "note") || strings.Contains(raw, "vendor") {
		t.Fatalf("known variant was not normalized: %s", raw)
	}
	custom, err := Decode[Message]([]byte(`{"kind":"future","text":42,"note":42,"_meta":42,"vendor":9007199254740993,"constructor":true,"__proto__":false}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	encoded, err = json.Marshal(custom)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw = string(encoded)
	if !strings.Contains(raw, `"vendor":9007199254740993`) || !strings.Contains(raw, `"note":42`) || !strings.Contains(raw, `"constructor":true`) {
		t.Fatalf("custom payload lost: %s", raw)
	}
	if strings.Contains(raw, `"_meta"`) || strings.Contains(raw, `"__proto__"`) {
		t.Fatalf("salvaged/excluded fields restored: %s", raw)
	}
	if _, ok := custom.Variant().(MessageCustom); !ok {
		t.Fatalf("custom payload decoded as %T", custom.Variant())
	}
}
func TestZodStringConstraints(t *testing.T) {
	for _, source := range []string{`"usd"`, `"US"`, `123`} {
		if Validate[Currency]([]byte(source)) == nil {
			t.Fatalf("accepted currency %s", source)
		}
	}
	if Validate[Currency]([]byte(`"USD"`)) != nil {
		t.Fatal("rejected USD")
	}
	if Validate[URL]([]byte(`"relative/path"`)) == nil || Validate[URL]([]byte(`"https://"`)) == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted invalid URL")
	}
	if Validate[URL]([]byte(`"mailto:user@example.com"`)) != nil {
		t.Fatal("rejected absolute opaque URL")
	}
	if Validate[Timestamp]([]byte(`"2026-09-22T10:20:30+09:00"`)) != nil {
		t.Fatal("rejected offset datetime")
	}
	if Validate[Timestamp]([]byte(`"2026-02-30T10:20:30Z"`)) == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted invalid date")
	}
}

func TestValidatedOption(t *testing.T) {
	var holder struct {
		Inner Options `json:"inner"`
		List  []Count `json:"list"`
	}
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"inner":{"required":[1,"bad"]},"list":[1.0,2]}`), &holder, Validated)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if holder.Inner.Count != 3 || len(holder.Inner.Required) != 1 || holder.List[0] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("nested rules not applied: %+v", holder)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"inner":{"required":[]},"list":[11]}`), &holder, Validated); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("nested bound ignored")
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"inner":{"required":[]},"list":[11]}`), &holder); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("plain decoding must stay lenient")
	}
	if _, err := Decode[struct{}]([]byte(`{}`)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("unknown type accepted")
	}
}
